decisions.reason: As a low-cost, homepage-promoted extension that can create partnerships and learning around circular technologies, the accelerator still has option value after only one year and does not yet warrant abandonment.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder is the least aligned with the firm's machinery-focused core and existing customer needs, so with several stronger adjacent options available it is the best candidate to discontinue.

The infectious-waste decontamination plant fits closely with the firm's decentralized waste-treatment capabilities, and after just one year there is still meaningful uncertainty and upside worth preserving.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is strongly aligned with the firm's core modular recycling offer and decentralization strategy, making it a valuable option to retain while the market opportunity develops.
